newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RNA Holdings says IPO 30 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: RNA Holdings says IPO 30 times subscribed.

text.p: RNA Holdings Ltd, spun-off from Hong Kong metals company Tem Fat Hing Fung (Holdings) Ltd, said on Tuesday the initial public offering (IPO) of 168 million shares at HK$1.01 per share was 30 times subscribed. The net proceeds would be used to reduce bank borrowings, improve its management system and develop a gold and jewellery centre in Penang, Malaysia, it said in a statement.
RNA said it was expected to be listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange in early December.
Tem Fat Hing Fung is a bullion and jewellery trader while RNA engages in refining, casting, assaying and wholesaling precious metals.
